nodes.label: HILS Mode (Hardware-in-the-Loop)
nodes.rationale: Lock-step execution between laptop plant simulation and real ESP32 via MQTT (seq, v_dust, v_mq) with shadow mode parity verification.

nodes.label: MQTT Telemetry and Command Topics
nodes.rationale: Exposes karhutla/t/*, karhutla/f/*, karhutla/status for mobile dashboards and accepts AUTO, FORCE_MAX, FORCE_OFF, RESET on karhutla/cmd.

nodes.label: Riil Mode (Field Deployment)
nodes.rationale: Physical deployment with Sharp GP2Y1010AU0F and MQ-135 sensors on ESP32 and field_node.py for forecasting and daily CSV logging.

nodes.label: SITL Mode (Software-in-the-Loop)
nodes.rationale: Allows testing 4 scenarios (clean, smolder, flaming, fault) without physical hardware using core.py and plant.py.

nodes.label: ESP32 Hardware Wiring & Calibration
nodes.rationale: Uses 10k/20k voltage dividers on GPIO34 (Sharp Vo) and GPIO35 (MQ-135 AO), GPIO4 for Sharp LED, GPIO18 for MOSFET fan gate; requires manual air calibration in config.py and config.h to avoid auto-calibrating in smoky rooms.

nodes.label: Karhutla Edge-IoT System
nodes.rationale: Unified algorithm running across three execution modes: SITL, HILS, and Real-world hardware.

nodes.label: Virtual Firmware Pipeline (median3 -> Kalman 2-state -> fusi -> FSM -> PWM -> failsafe)
nodes.norm_label: virtual firmware pipeline (median3 -> kalman 2-state -> fusi -> fsm -> pwm -> failsafe)
nodes.rationale: Early alarm before PM reaches 55 ug/m3 is intentional due to lead term dC/dt and gas score.

nodes.label: FAILSAFE Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Triggered when sensor disconnects/out-of-range >=5s or HILS data stops >5s; sets fan to 70% + alarm while still honoring FORCE_OFF from phone.
